verdict.rationale: The only first-party search-related evidence is Ask AI, which answers natural-language questions over the inbox (e.g. "when is my flight") "without having to remember senders, guess keywords". That is AI retrieval rather than precise operator- and filter-based search. Hands-on reports on speed conflict: one ex-user says archive searches regularly took ten seconds versus instant in Gmail, while another user calls search blazing fast. missing for 10: documented search operators, filters, ranked result ordering, explicit full-history coverage, consistent independent confirmation of search speed.
